selected.title: Starling becomes first bank to train AI model on UK sovereign cloud
selected.summary: Starling is working with AI chip making giant Nvidia to build a transactional foundational model that is trained and hosted within a UK sovereign cloud.
selected.why: First UK bank to train foundational AI model on sovereign cloud.

reason: UK bank training AI on sovereign cloud raises real questions about whether data sovereignty requirements benefit or harm financial innovation and competition
angle: Mandatory sovereign AI infrastructure may protect data but will entrench incumbent banks over challengers who lack resources for parallel systems
